tools.name: site_overview
tools.description: Describe this website, who publishes it (Yazılım Koçu, a Turkish software company), its topics and the other sites in the network. Call this first when you need context about the site.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search published articles, buyer guides, solution pages, tools and design demos. On a satellite site, results from that site come first, followed by the most relevant Yazılım Koçu pages. Use get_page to read a result. Queries work best in Turkish (e.g. "e-fatura", "trendyol komisyon", "web sitesi fi

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch a page from Yazılım Koçu or one of its five satellite sites and return its readable text (title, description, body as lightweight markdown, max ~12k characters). Only these domains are allowed: yazilimkocu.com, belediyeyazilimlari.com, erpyazilimlari.com, crmyazilimlari.com, pazaryeriyazilimla

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Return Yazılım Koçu's published prices in TRY (VAT excluded): website packages and add-ons, e-commerce package bases and add-ons, typical ranges for custom software (web app, mobile, marketplace, enterprise/ERP/CRM, AI), and AI training programs. These are the same numbers shown on the website; neve

tools.name: start_project_request
tools.description: When the user wants an offer, a meeting or to start a project or training, return the exact Yazılım Koçu form link for that need. Do NOT collect personal data (name, e-mail, phone) in the chat: the user fills the form and gives KVKK consent there.

tools.name: quote_website
tools.description: Calculate the exact price of a Yazılım Koçu corporate website from a package, add-ons and number of languages, using the same formula as the website configurator. Returns VAT-excluded and VAT-included totals, delivery days and a link that opens the configurator with this selection pre-filled.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List Yazılım Koçu's services (website, e-commerce, custom software, mobile, AI, training), sector solution pages, products and free assessment tools, each with its URL.

tools.name: list_design_demos
tools.description: List Yazılım Koçu's live website and e-commerce design demos (each has a stable code like WS-012 / ET-007, a sector and a preview URL). Filter by category, group or a free-text sector query. A website demo code can be passed to quote_website.

tools.name: get_training_options
tools.description: Return Yazılım Koçu's AI & production training formats (one-to-one, in-person group, online group, corporate) with duration, capacity, location and price, the Entrepreneurship Program, and the next cohort start date with its registration deadline.

tools.name: get_assessment
tools.description: List Yazılım Koçu's free self-assessment tools (e.g. AI readiness), or, given tool_id, return its questions and answer options so you can ask the user and then call score_assessment.

tools.name: score_assessment
tools.description: Score a free self-assessment: pass tool_id and the chosen option values in question order. Returns the tier, explanation and recommendations (same scoring as the website).

tools.name: get_frameworks
tools.description: List Yazılım Koçu's published decision frameworks (e.g. 4VS, TBAM, 3DR) or return one in full by code, with citation-ready definitions and canonical URLs.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Compare two Yazılım Koçu frameworks (by code) or two sector solution pages (by slug, e.g. "finans" vs "uretim"). Sector metrics are representative targets, not measured client results.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_frameworks" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
